title: Customer Success Manager, Southern Europe
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

À propos du poste

Rejoignez l'équipe Customer Success d'Anthropic en tant que Customer Success Manager basé(e) dans la région EMEA, alors que nous façonnons l'avenir de l'adoption de l'IA en entreprise. En tant que Customer Success Manager chez Anthropic, vous serez partenaire stratégique et conseiller de confiance de nos clients les plus complexes dans la zone EMEA, les aidant à exploiter pleinement le potentiel de toutes nos fonctionnalités Claude : API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code.

Vous développerez de véritables partenariats avec les clients, acquérant une compréhension approfondie de leurs objectifs commerciaux, de leur orientation stratégique, de leur vision en IA et de leurs besoins techniques. Vous ferez appel à la fois à votre sens des affaires et à votre expertise technique pour agir comme conseiller stratégique tout au long de leur parcours chez nous.

En partenariat avec l'ensemble de l'équipe chargée des comptes, vous aiderez les clients à identifier les fonctionnalités Claude les mieux adaptées à leurs objectifs commerciaux spécifiques, en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec eux pour leur fournir les meilleures pratiques et des conseils, tout en les aidant dans la croissance et l'évolution de leur utilisation (consommation et base) sur le siège.

Votre rôle consiste à aider les clients à adapter efficacement leur utilisation, à mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement, à optimiser les cas d'utilisation et à maximiser la valeur de leur investissement en élargissant les cas d'utilisation à l'ensemble de leur organisation. Les informations que vous recueillerez auprès de vos clients serviront directement à définir nos priorités en matière de recherche, de développement et

de stratégies de commercialisation, vous permettant de jouer un rôle clé dans la manière dont nous créons et fournissons de la valeur en continu en tant qu'entreprise.

En tant que l'un de nos premiers CSM dans la région EMEA, vous serez une pionnière en aidant à mettre en place des processus régionaux, à établir de nouvelles relations avec les clients et en représentant la marque Anthropic dans un

marché en forte croissance. Vous travaillerez avec une grande autonomie tout en maintenant un alignement fort avec les équipes mondiales, ce qui requiert une personne qui s'épanouit dans des environnements ambigus et peut travailler efficacement dans différents fuseaux horaires.

Responsabilités :

  • Établir des relations de confiance et stratégiques avec les décideurs clés des clients EMEA afin de comprendre leurs activités et leurs objectifs, en identifiant des opportunités d'optimisation et d'expansion
  • Devenir expert des produits Anthropic via API, Claude for Enterprise et Claude Code, en comprenant les nuances techniques et les meilleures pratiques de chacun afin d'orienter les clients vers les bonnes solutions
  • Tirer parti de votre connaissance approfondie du client et des spécificités régionales pour piloter de manière proactive la planification de l'utilisation, en cernant les tendances actuelles et futures en matière de consommation et d'adoption, ainsi que la manière dont celles-ci se traduisent en valeur ajoutée pour le client
  • Surveiller les schémas d'utilisation et identifiez les opportunités d'optimisation, en traitant de manière proactive la sous-utilisation des produits basés sur la consommation (API) et par abonnement (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) pour tirer pleinement parti des engagements contractuels
  • Jouer le rôle de partenaire stratégique auprès des clients, en enrichissant leur connaissance des produits Claude grâce à la diffusion de la feuille de route des produits d'Anthropic, en faisant connaître les nouveaux produits et en impliquant les chefs de produit pour qu'ils se fassent le porte-parole des clients de la région EMEA
  • Documenter et quantifier la valeur client réalisée grâce aux résultats commerciaux, au ROI et aux indicateurs d'impact afin de constituer des arguments commerciaux internes convaincants en vue de poursuivre et d'accroître les investissements
  • Identifier les cas d'utilisation potentiels et les secteurs d'activité qui ne sont pas encore exploités, en collaborant avec les clients pour découvrir de nouvelles applications pour Claude au sein des différents services, équipes et flux de travail
  • Élaborer et mettre en œuvre des stratégies de gestion du changement pour favoriser l'adoption par les utilisateurs finaux et maximiser la valeur au sein des organisations clientes, y compris des programmes de formation des formateurs, le développement de centres d'excellence et l'accompagnement organisationnel
  • Gérer l'expérience client tout au long de son cycle de vie : gérer des comptes complets et des plans de réussite fondés sur les objectifs commerciaux du client, réaliser des bilans commerciaux trimestriels et servir de principal intermédiaire entre le client et Anthropic
  • Contribuer au développement de la marque Anthropic et des relations avec la clientèle en tant que membre de la première équipe de service client de la région, en élaborant, si nécessaire, des processus, des guides opérationnels et des bonnes pratiques adaptés à la zone EMEA et tenant compte des cultures d'entreprise régionales



Profil recherché :

  • Vous avez plus de 6 ans d'expérience dans des fonctions en contact avec la clientèle (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/ Functional Consultant, Success Engineer ou similaire)
  • Expérience avérée en matière de réussite dans les modèles commerciaux basés sur la consommation et sur la location de places, avec une bonne compréhension des différents leviers de croissance et des indicateurs de performance associés
  • Maîtrise technique et capacité à comprendre et à articuler les concepts d'IA/ML, les intégrations d'API et les modèles de mise en œuvre logicielle
  • Expérience dans la présentation et la démonstration de produits techniques auprès de publics variés
  • Mentalité stratégique pour identifier les opportunités de croissance et les traduire en plans d'expansion concrets
  • Collaborateur polyvalent qui représente le client avec positivité et proactivité, en mobilisant l'ensemble de l'équipe autour de solutions permettant de répondre aux besoins du client
  • Solides compétences en gestion de projet et capacité à gérer plusieurs relations clients
  • Passion pour l'IA et intérêt pour le développement responsable de systèmes avancés
  • Acquérir de l'expérience en travaillant et en contribuant au développement d'une région en pleine croissance, tout en jonglant avec les fuseaux horaires depuis le siège social situé aux États-Unis
  • Un talent pour mettre de l'ordre dans le chaos et une mentalité enthousiaste de « retrousser ses manches ». Vous avez l'esprit d'équipe
  • (Bonus) Maîtrise du français, de l'allemand, de l'espagnol ou de l'italien

About the role

Join Anthropic's Customer Success team as an EMEA based Customer Success Manager as we pioneer the future of enterprise AI adoption. As a Customer Success Manager at Anthropic, you'll be the strategic partner and trusted advisor to our most complex customers across EMEA helping them harness the full potential of all our Claude capabilities - API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code.

You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers, gaining a deep understanding of their business objectives, strategic direction, AI vision, and technical needs. You'll draw on both your business acumen and technical expertise to serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us.

In partnership with the broader account team you will help customers identify the right Claude capabilities for their specific business objectives, working closely with them to provide best practices and guidance while supporting them as their usage (consumption & seat based) grows and evolves.

Your role focuses on helping customers scale their usage effectively, implement change management strategies, optimize use cases, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. The insights you gather from your customers will directly inform our research priorities, product development, and go-to-market strategies — making you a key voice in shaping how we build and deliver ongoing value as a business.

As one of our early CSMs in EMEA, you'll be a pioneer - helping to build regional processes, establishing new customer relationships, and representing Anthropic's brand in a high-growth market. You'll operate with significant autonomy while maintaining strong alignment with global teams, requiring someone who thrives in ambiguous environments and can work effectively across time zones.

Responsibilities:

  • Build trusting, strategic relationships with key EMEA customer decision makers to understand their business and objectives, identifying opportunities for optimization and expansion
  • Become an expert in Anthropic's products across API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code, understanding the technical nuances and best practices for each to guide customers to the right solutions
  • Leverage your deep knowledge of the customer and regional nuances to proactively drive usage planning, understanding current and future consumption/ adoption and how it creates realized value for the customer
  • Monitor usage patterns and identify optimization opportunities, proactively addressing underutilization across both consumption-based (API) and seat-based (Claude for Enterprise / Claude Code) products to drive full value from contracted commitments
  • Serve as the customer’s thought partner, enhancing their knowledge of Claude products by socializing Anthropic’s product roadmap, driving awareness on new products and engaging Product PMs as the voice of EMEA customers
  • Document and quantify customer value realized through business outcomes, ROI, and impact metrics to build compelling internal business cases for continued and expanded investment
  • Identify potential use cases and lines of business not currently onboarded, partnering with customers to discover new applications for Claude across different departments, teams, and workflows
  • Develop and execute change management strategies to drive end-user adoption and maximize value within customer organizations, including Train the Trainer programs, Center of Excellence development, and organizational enablement
  • Own the customer experience across their lifecycle — managing comprehensive account and success plans grounded in the customer's business objectives, conducting Quarterly Business Reviews, and serving as the primary conduit between the customer and Anthropic
  • Build Anthropic's brand and customer relationships as a member of the first in-region CS team, developing EMEA-specific processes, playbooks, and best practices where needed that account for regional business cultures

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 6+ years of experience in customer-facing roles (Customer Success, Consulting, Solutions Architect, Solutions/ Functional Consultant, Success Engineer or similar)
  • Experience driving success across both consumption-based and seat-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
  • Strong Technical fluency with ability to understand and articulate AI/ML concepts, API integrations, and software implementation patterns
  • Experience explaining and demonstrating technical products to various audiences
  • Strategic mindset to identify growth opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans
  • Cross-functional collaborator who represents the customer in a positive, proactive manner, rallying everyone around paths forward that solve customer needs
  • Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple customer relationships
  • Passion for AI and interest in responsible development of advanced systems
  • Experience working in and building a growing region, while navigating across time zones with US-based headquarters
  • A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic 'roll up your sleeves' mentality. You are a true team player
  • Fluency in French, Spanish and English

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
€150.000—€190.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Business Development Lead, Life Sciences
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Partnerships team develops external relationships that advance our research and products and expand how organizations can benefit from AI. Within life sciences, we work across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, AI-native discovery platforms, research institutions, and experimental labs. We partner closely with Research, Product, Engineering, Safety, GTM, Legal, and Finance to turn complex scientific, technical, and commercial opportunities into durable partnerships.

About the Role

We are hiring a Life Sciences Partnerships Lead to shape and execute OpenAI’s global life sciences partnership strategy. You will lead high-impact research, product, and platform partnerships across the life sciences ecosystem.

You will help determine where OpenAI should invest deeply with strategic partners, where we should enable a broader ecosystem, and how research, product, safety, and commercial considerations should shape our decisions. You will bring the voice of life sciences partners into OpenAI while helping internal teams turn ambiguous opportunities into clear decisions and executable plans.

This role requires scientific and commercial fluency, strong judgment, and the ability to move complex partnerships from strategy through execution and measurable impact.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead full-lifecycle strategic partnerships, from partner strategy and executive alignment through scoping, commercial negotiation, execution, and ongoing operating reviews.

  • Identify and prioritize opportunities across pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, AI-native discovery platforms, research institutions, and experimental labs.

  • Work closely with Research, Product, and Engineering to translate partner needs, scientific workflows, technical constraints, and market dynamics into product and program recommendations.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, Safety, Research, and other cross-functional teams to structure partnerships with the appropriate data, deployment, governance, and commercial models.

  • Coordinate with Health, GTM, GSI/MSSP enablement, and cloud service provider partnership teams to turn strategic relationships into broader ecosystem adoption and measurable impact.

  • Build trusted relationships with senior executives, scientific leaders, and technical counterparts across the life sciences ecosystem.

  • Bring structure to ambiguous opportunities, clear blockers across internal and external teams, and communicate decisions and tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 12+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, product partnerships, business development, or general management across the life sciences and technology industries.

  • Bring a deep understanding of the life sciences ecosystem, including its scientific workflows, business models, incentives, and key industry dynamics.

  • Have led complex strategic partnerships spanning research or scientific collaboration, technical execution, commercial terms, go-to-market strategy, and long-term platform alignment.

  • Can engage credibly with scientific, technical, product, and business leaders and translate between their priorities.

  • Are an effective cross-functional leader who can drive progress through influence rather than formal authority.

  • Communicate clearly, think structurally, and make sound prioritization decisions in fast-moving and ambiguous environments.

  • Exercise exceptional judgment and integrity.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

This is a commercial role first. You will build joint business plans with partner leadership, work with your partners' sales teams on live opportunities, team up with Anthropic's Partner Sales team to bring those partners into the right accounts, and keep a clear, accurate view of how each partner is performing. You will work closely with our Partner Sales, Partner Programs, Partner Support, Partner Activations, and Partner Success teams so your partners get the full value of what Anthropic offers, and you will bring what you hear from partners back to those teams.

This role reports to the Head of Boutique & AI-Native SIs and works closely with sales, product, and applied AI teams to make sure our SI partners are equipped to win and deliver transformative AI solutions for their clients.

Responsibilities

Partner Development and Go-to-Market

  • Own and manage relationships with a portfolio of key AI-native and boutique SI partners, from practitioners through to founders and executive leadership

  • Develop and execute joint go-to-market strategies that drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline

  • Lead partner business planning, including setting mutual goals, identifying target accounts, and defining success metrics

  • Work directly with your partners' sales teams to identify opportunities and support deal progression

  • Partner closely with Anthropic's Partner Sales team, who lead introductions and co-sell with our account executives and account teams, so your partners are positioned on the right accounts and opportunities

  • Run a regular operating cadence with each partner, including business reviews against the joint plan

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work hand in hand with Partner Sales as your primary go-to-market counterpart. You own the partner relationship and the joint business plan; Partner Sales works with Anthropic's sales leaders, account executives, and solutions architects to bring your partners into deals at the right time with clear roles, and owns co-sell execution and the partner-linked pipeline and forecast

  • Work side by side with Partner Success Leads on the partners you share. You own the overall partner relationship and the commercial plan; the Partner Success Lead owns each customer engagement from partner match to completed outcome, including delivery quality and the customer's Claude usage

  • Build executive-level trust with each partner's practice and delivery leadership together with Partner Success, so that when an engagement needs the partner to restaff, escalate, or invest, the ask is taken seriously

  • Align with Partner Success on how each partner's Claude practice is growing, including certified bench depth, a repeatable offering in a chosen industry lane, and published customer stories, and carry that into the joint business plan and go-to-market

  • Bring the commercial view to the quarterly practice reviews Partner Success runs with each partner, so the partner hears one set of joint goals across pipeline, completed engagements, customer adoption, and certified practitioners

  • Keep the handoffs clean: with Partner Sales when a partner deal closes, and with Partner Success when an engagement is matched to one of your partners, so both teams have what you know about the partner's strengths, capacity, and proof points

  • Work with Partner Programs to help your partners understand and progress through Claude Partner Network tiers, requirements, and benefits

  • Work with Partner Activations to bring your partners into the customer engagements where they can have the most impact

  • Work with Partner Support to get partner questions and issues resolved quickly, and to spot patterns worth fixing at the source

  • Work with Partner Enablement so partners have the training, certification pathways, and technical resources they need to build and deliver with Claude

  • Serve as the voice of your partners inside Anthropic, informing program, enablement, and product priorities

Partner Operations and Performance Tracking

  • Maintain accurate tracking of partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue using our existing systems, tools, and processes, including deal registration and CRM discipline

  • Keep partner performance dashboards and reporting current, and use them to run partner reviews and internal updates

  • Follow our standard operating procedures for partner activities, and help keep them documented and up to date

  • Maintain partner data integrity and consistent measurement across your portfolio

  • Track KPIs for each partner and for the overall health of your portfolio

  • Assess partner contribution, engagement, and growth potential using established frameworks, and recommend where Anthropic should invest

  • Track and report the return on partner investments such as funding and enablement, and give Partner Success your recommendation on funding requests from your partners

  • Identify opportunities to improve how we work with partners and bring them to the teams that own those programs

You may be a good fit if you have

  • 5+ years of experience in partner development, channel management, or partner management

  • Demonstrated success driving revenue through partners, with pipeline and bookings results you can point to

  • Experience working with systems integrators, consulting firms, or similar enterprise-focused services partners

  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to support deal progression and navigate complex partner relationships

  • A commercial orientation: you are a business driver first and a relationship manager second, and you are comfortable asking a partner to invest in its own capability

  • Strong analytical skills, with experience tracking KPIs, working from dashboards, and using data to decide where to spend your time

  • Outstanding communication and relationship-building skills at all levels, from partner practitioners to founders and executives

  • A track record of working well across functions to get things done for partners without owning every team involved

  • Experience with CRM systems and partner relationship management tools

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a fast-changing environment

  • Low ego, high curiosity, and a habit of making the people around you better

  • Willingness to travel to support partner relationships and joint customer engagements

  • A background working at or with AI-native services firms, boutique consultancies, or systems integrators

  • An understanding of how boutique services firms run, including how they staff, price, and fund a new practice

  • An understanding of enterprise sales cycles and how partners influence complex, multi-stakeholder deals

  • Hands-on familiarity with Claude, Claude Code, and how enterprises build and deploy LLM applications

  • Experience at a high-growth company where the program was still being built

  • Passion for AI and an understanding of how enterprises are adopting AI technologies

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$215,000—$300,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: B2B Ecosystem Lead, Business Development
description:
About the Team:

We are a small and fast-moving B2B partnerships team that shapes and executes OpenAI’s most important collaborations. We develop strategic and product partnerships across the B2B ecosystem, bringing together OpenAI’s capabilities and partners’ technology, expertise, data, workflows, and customer relationships. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and Sales, we turn these opportunities into useful offerings and new ways for businesses to adopt and benefit from OpenAI.

About the Role:

As a B2B Ecosystem Lead, you will identify, develop, and execute strategic and product partnerships across B2B segments. This is a hands-on individual contributor role spanning opportunity assessment, partnership design, commercial negotiation, and execution. You will own the partner work behind product initiatives, from defining partner needs through launch and sustained adoption at scale. These may include Sign in with ChatGPT and industry-specific offerings. You bring a generalist’s ability to connect product priorities with partner capabilities, build a business case, and align teams around a practical path forward. You will remain accountable after signing and launch, including for selected high-touch strategic partnerships.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify strategic and product partnership opportunities across B2B segments; translate product priorities and customer needs into partner plans, joint value propositions, and a focused set of prospective partners.

  • Own the partner work stream for assigned product initiatives, aligning requirements, commitments, milestones, and ongoing responsibilities with Product, Engineering, and partner teams.

  • Develop business cases and negotiate product and commercial partnerships with Legal, Finance, and Product, including selected high-touch strategic deals in coordination with other partnership owners.

  • Take partner initiatives from pilot through launch and scale, defining readiness criteria, coordinating integrations, and expanding successful offerings to more partners and business customers.

  • Work with Sales and partner teams on target accounts, referrals, joint selling, and customer introductions, with clear responsibilities for follow-up and opportunity tracking.

  • Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, Security, Policy, and Operations to resolve launch and adoption barriers, with clear ownership and handoffs into ongoing partner programs.

  • Maintain partner relationships after launch and bring customer feedback, integration gaps, and adoption barriers back to Product and Engineering; help turn early implementations into repeatable offerings.

  • Define success measures with product and go-to-market teams, track activation, sustained usage, customer outcomes, and commercial impact, and drive follow-up when an initiative falls short.

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, strategic or product partnerships, or related roles developing commercial opportunities in technology or other B2B businesses.

  • Experience developing B2B partnerships and taking a product, integration, or partner initiative from concept or pilot through launch and sustained adoption, working closely with product and technical teams.

  • A broad business perspective and the ability to learn unfamiliar industries, evaluate partner capabilities and strategic fit, and turn an ambiguous opportunity into a clear business case and partnership plan.

  • Understanding of how businesses use software, data, and services, and how product integrations, distribution, and complementary capabilities create value. Experience across B2B sectors and business models is a plus.

  • Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to assess economics, prioritize competing opportunities, and use performance data to guide decisions.

  • Ability to build relationships with partner practitioners and leaders, work effectively across technical and business teams, and move projects forward without formal authority.

  • Clear writing and communication, curiosity about AI, and a willingness to do the detailed work of growing partnerships. You combine initiative and adaptability with disciplined follow-through.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement.

Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

title: (Canada) Sales Development Representative (6 month contract)
description:
The Role: As an entry-level sales position, the Sales Development Representative (SDR) will support a Senior Sales Executive and be responsible for day-to-day interactions with our prospective customers in the health care industry. The SDR, as part of a larger team, plays a major role in the company's business development efforts, from establishing initial contact with customers and potential customers to facilitating follow up activities that lead to new business opportunities. The primary responsibility for the SDR will be to schedule conference calls and meetings for the VP of Sales with prospects that likely have never heard of our company.
Who you'll work with: You will be part of our growing sales team with the ability to directly impact the success of the organization. You'll be working directly with our Sales Team, Director of Sales Operations, Product Team, Marketing and much more.
Contract Length: 6 months with potential to extend

What you'll be doing day to day:

  • Develop strong content knowledge of the healthcare industry
  • Research potential prospects
  • Create a strategic outreach plan with Vice President of Sales to target prospective customers
  • Cold call and email to schedule meetings and conference calls.
  • Identify and target prospective ED Medical Directors, CMOs, and other healthcare executives through strategic planning and execution
  • Communicate with prospective customers including chief health care executives using creative outreach methods via email and phone
  • Achieve weekly, monthly and quarterly goals through scheduling of meetings and appointments for Vice President of Sales with prospective customers
  • Prepare background material and market research in preparation for all sales meetings and appointments
  • Manage post-sales meeting follow up such as scheduling follow up calls and assisting with the new customer sales process
  • Maintain internal database to track key performance metrics and sales and marketing activities
  • Own calendaring, logistics and administrative responsibilities for all pieces of the sales process for the Vice President of Sales
  • Manage special projects as necessary

Skills and experience we're looking for:

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience
  • Customer service experience
  • Experience working in a team environment
  • Sales or fundraising experience
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proven ability to meet and exceed goals
  • Ability to communicate by e-mail and phone
  • Ability to overcome challenges or obstacles in the moment
  • Attention to detail
